C45036.observed: What was checked: that the new part row in Full View offers six boxes, in the order the specification lists. What happened: reading them left to right on screen, the row showed Description, Part number, Qty, Category, Cost, Sell price - six boxes, in exactly that order, all of them editable.

C45041.observed: What was checked: that the Full View row offers a Save, a "More options", and a close action. What happened: all three were present on the row - "More options", "Save", and a close (×) button at the end.

C45042.observed: What was checked: that a part cannot be saved unless the description, quantity, cost and sell price are all filled in, while the part number and category stay optional. What happened: filling in only a description and pressing Save did not save anything. The row stayed open and the message "Enter a qty, cost and sell price to save this part." appeared, naming exactly the three that were missing. Nothing complained about the part number or the category, so those are indeed optional. A part filled in with all four did save.

C45043.observed: What was checked: that saving a part puts it at the top of that line's parts list, shows a confirmation message, and immediately opens a fresh empty row ready for the next part. What happened: before saving, the top part on the line was "ZZAUTOTEST enter-save". After saving a new part it appeared above that one - first in the list. A green "Part added" message appeared. A new empty row opened straight away with the cursor already in the Description box, so you can keep adding parts without reaching for the mouse.

C45044.observed: What was checked: that "More options" opens the full part details window. What happened: pressing "More options" opened the window headed "New Part Request", which is the correct heading when you are adding a part rather than editing one.

C45045.observed: What was checked: that anything already typed into the quick row is carried into the bigger part details window, so nothing has to be typed twice. What happened: the row was filled in with description "ZZAUTOTEST fullview part", quantity 3, cost 12.50 and sell price 25.00. Opening "More options" showed every one of those values already in place in the window, and it had also worked out the Margin (50) from the cost and sell price.

C45047.observed: What was checked: that backing out of the part details window throws nothing away and puts you back on the quick row exactly as you left it. What happened: tested both ways the window can be closed - the × button and the Escape key. Neither showed any "are you sure" prompt, and neither discarded anything. Both times the quick row was still there with its original values intact (description "ZZAUTOTEST cancel-X", quantity 4, cost 5.00, sell price 9.00). A quantity changed to 77 inside the window did NOT come back to the row, which is what the test requires.

What happened: starting in the Description box, Tab moved through Description, Part number, Qty, Category, Cost, Sell price, Save, the close (×) button, then "More options" - which sits to the left of Save on screen but comes last when tabbing, exactly as the test describes.
